title: Financial Controller - CPA
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and detail-oriented Financial Controller (CPA) to oversee and manage our financial operations. This role goes beyond traditional bookkeeping and focuses on financial reporting, compliance, and supporting business decisions, particularly within the fund/investment industry.



Must Have:

-CPA license (Certified Public Accountant)

-5+ years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial management

-Experience in fund or investment industry

-Strong experience in U.S.-based accounting

-Proven experience in reviewing and analyzing financial statements

-Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software

-Deep understanding of GAAP and financial compliance

-Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy

-Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills

-Ability to work independently and take ownership of financial processes

-Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field



Responsibilities:

-Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial operations

-Review and analyze financial statements and reports

-Ensure accuracy of bookkeeping, journal entries, and reconciliations

-Maintain compliance with GAAP and financial regulations

-Support audits and ensure proper documentation of financial records

-Identify discrepancies and provide solutions for financial improvements

-Collaborate with internal teams to support financial decision-making

-Improve financial processes and workflows when needed



Nice to Have:

-Experience in fund accounting, venture capital, or investment firms

-Background in handling multi-entity or international accounts

-Experience working with remote or global teams

-Strong communication skills and ability to explain financial data clearly



What We’re Looking For:



We are looking for someone with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and professionalism—similar to a Controller role—who can not only manage financial records but also ensure accuracy, compliance, and reliability of financial data and can work in an intensive environment.

title: Telemarketing Specialist (Ecosystem-Wide)
description:
About RJEC Enterprise Ecosystem

At RJEC Enterprise Ecosystem, we don’t just operate in one lane—we run the entire highway. As a diverse ecosystem of businesses spanning multiple industries, we deliver a wide array of products and services to different markets. Because our portfolio is so vast, we don't look for standard "script-readers." We are seeking dynamic, adaptable, and quick-witted conversationalists who can easily pivot from pitching B2B services to engaging B2C consumers.



Our Philosophy: We believe every call is an opportunity to connect a customer with the exact solution they need from our diverse business ecosystem. If you love variety, challenge, and uncapped growth, you’ll fit right in.



Role Overview:



As a Telemarketing Specialist, you will be the voice of the RJEC Enterprise Ecosystem. You will drive growth by identifying opportunities, sparking interest, and qualifying leads across our various business units. This is a highly collaborative role requiring agility, as your campaigns may shift to support different brands within our ecosystem. 



Role Quick Facts:

Details:

Primary Focus: Lead generation, outbound calling, ecosystem brand awareness

Target Audience: B2B & B2C (depending on the active campaign)

Tools Used: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), VoIP systems, internal communication channels

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Lead conversion rate, call volume, appointment setting, database accuracy



Key Responsibilities

Diverse Campaign Outreach: Execute outbound call campaigns for various businesses within the RJEC ecosystem, seamlessly transitioning between different brand voices and value propositions.



Lead Generation & Qualification: Identify high-potential prospects, qualify leads, and schedule appointments/demos for our specialized sales teams.



Relationship Building: Initiate warm, engaging conversations with potential clients; answer preliminary questions and handle objections with professionalism and tact.



CRM Management: Maintain meticulous records of all interactions, follow-ups, and lead statuses in our centralized CRM system.



Feedback Loop: Collaborate closely with marketing and product managers from different business units to share customer feedback and help optimize campaigns.



Product Knowledge Mastery: Quickly grasp the core offerings of new businesses integrated into the ecosystem to ensure accurate and compelling pitches.



Who You Are (Requirements & Qualifications)

The Adaptable Communicator: You have 1–3 years of experience in telemarketing, inside sales, or customer service (experience in a multi-client or agency setting is a major plus).



A Natural Conversationalist: You possess outstanding verbal and written communication skills. You don't just read scripts; you build rapport.



Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable working with CRMs, dialers, and standard office software (e.g., G-Suite, Slack).



Resilient & Positive: You view a "no" as just a stepping stone to the next "yes" and maintain high energy throughout your shift.



A Quick Study: You can absorb product information rapidly and pivot your sales strategy based on the business unit you are representing.



What We Offer:

Unmatched Career Growth: This is a long term role and working in an ecosyste
ans horizontal and vertical mobility. If you excel here, you can transition into account management, marketing, or leadership roles across any of our business units.

Comprehensive Training: We will teach you the ins and outs of our diverse industries.

A Vibrant Culture: Collaborate with a supportive, forward-thinking team that celebrates your wins.



To prove you actually read this job description, please follow these instructions exactly:



1. Change your application subject line to: "RJEC Caller: [Your Favorite Animal]"  (For example: RJEC Caller: Golden Retriever). 

2. Start the very first line of your message/cover letter with this exact sentence: "I am ready to pitch the entire RJEC ecosystem."

3. In 2 sentences or less, tell us about the hardest objection you've ever overcome on a phone call and how you handled it.



Applications that use the default template, have generic subject lines, or miss these steps will be archived immediately without being read. Show us your personality!

title: Minecraft Survival Gameplay Recorder (1080p60 + Shaders) — Long-Term
description:
I need someone to play Minecraft Survival and record their screen. That's it. No editing, no commentary, no face cam.



THE WORK

- Play vanilla Minecraft Survival on a world I provide (or a fresh one).

- Record continuous 1-hour sessions with OBS. Raw footage only — I do the editing.

- Deliver each session as one uncut file via Google Drive.

- Ongoing work. I need many hours of footage per month.



WHAT MAKES GOOD FOOTAGE (important)

- Constant movement and activity: building, mining, exploring, farming. No standing still, no long AFK, no menu-staring.

- Beautiful, cinematic-looking world. This footage is background visuals, so it needs to look good.

- Nothing distracting: no chat spam, no mods that add HUD clutter.



REQUIREMENTS

- Gaming PC that can run shaders (BSL, Complementary or similar) at 1080p 60fps WHILE recording with OBS. Modern GPU required (GTX 1660 / RTX 3050 or better).

- Fiber internet with at least 20 Mbps UPLOAD. Each session is ~10GB.

- OBS Studio installed and you know how to configure it.

- Reliable, can commit to a weekly schedule.



PAY

$3 USD per delivered hour of usable footage. Up to $4/hour for someone with a strong setup and consistently great footage. Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal.



TO APPLY — send me these 4 things (applications without them are ignored):

1. Your PC specs (CPU, GPU, RAM).

2. A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net) showing upload speed.

3. A 2-minute sample recording of you playing Minecraft with shaders at 1080p (upload to Google Drive or YouTube unlisted). This is the main thing I look at.

4. The word "CREEPER" at the top of your message so I know you read this.



If your sample is good, we start immediately.

title: Virtual Medical Assistant for US Ophthalmology Practice (Full-Time, Long-Term Career Position)
description:
Athena Eye Care is a premium ophthalmology practice in Mission Viejo, California, specializing in refractive cataract surgery and lens replacement surgery. I am Dr. Audrey Tai, the owner and surgeon. I am hiring a full-time Virtual Medical Assistant to join my remote team of three VMAs, all based in the Philippines, who handle phones, scheduling, billing, and my surgical pipeline.

This is not a task job. It is a career position on a growing team. My current VMAs started with phones and administrative work, and through training have expanded into new skill sets, including marketing and social media skills they have learned since joining the practice. I am looking for someone who wants the same path: to build a long-term career here, expand their skills year over year, and become a permanent part of this team. If you have the ability and the desire to grow, I will train you and give you the opportunity.



Your starting responsibilities:



Incoming patient calls: answering the practice phone line professionally and warmly, taking messages, and routing patient questions correctly

Outbound patient calls: calling patients to schedule their six-month and annual follow-up appointments, appointment reminders, and rescheduling patients who missed their visits

Simple data entry in our EHR (DrChrono): uploading documents, entering explanation of benefits, moving appointments, and keeping records organized

Supporting the team with call overflow during busy clinic hours



What you will grow into, with training:



Appointment and laser procedure authorizations with insurance

Post-operative note processing for surgical patients

Simple billing data entry

Expanded responsibilities beyond these as your skills and the practice grow



Requirements:



Excellent spoken and written English. You will speak with elderly American patients by phone daily, so a clear, warm, patient phone manner is essential

Strong organizational skills. You will manage a daily call list and task queue and are expected to keep it current without being chased

Preference will be given to applicants with a medical background: experience in a medical practice, clinic, hospital, or healthcare account (BPO healthcare accounts count)

Prior HIPAA training is highly valued. You must have knowledge of, and willingness to follow, HIPAA compliance strictly (we will also train you and require a signed confidentiality agreement)

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a good headset, and a backup power/internet plan

A VPN set up on your work computer for security reasons (we will provide guidance during onboarding)

Available full time during US Pacific business hours



About working with me: I train thoroughly, document our procedures step by step, and give you direct feedback in your first month so expectations are clear. You will work inside a well-organized system. I value every team member highly, and bringing a new team member on board is an investment I make and value: I invest my time in your training, and I am looking for someone who will invest in return by growing with this practice for years. As your experience and responsibilities expand, we will talk.



How to apply

To apply, please send:



Your updated resume

A short voice recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing your experience with patient or customer phone calls. This is required; applications without a voice recording will not be considered

One paragraph on your experience with medical or healthcare work, if any. Any certification of HIPAA training or EHR training from prior work experience is highly encouraged; please mention it in your answer

Your expected hourly rate and your internet speed test result (speedtest.net screenshot)



Working Hours

Full time, 40 hours/week, during US Pacific Time business hours (approximately 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PT, Monday to Friday). You must be available and reliable during this window.

Skill Requirements (select on the form)

English (speaking and writing), Customer Service, Phone Support, Data Entry, Medical Services, Admin Assistant, Scheduling

title: Game UI & Graphic Designer – StageTime
description:
About StageTime

StageTime is a social VR game for Meta Quest and Steam, similar to VRChat and Rec Room. Players hang out, customise their avatars, perform on stage and attend live community events.



We are looking for a talented designer to improve the visual quality of StageTime across the game, stores, website and promotional materials.



The role

Your first major project will be a complete rework of StageTime’s menu UI.



You will receive access to the Steam build and are expected to explore the game independently, understand how the current menus work and propose improvements. We want someone who can take ownership rather than needing every task explained in detail.



After the UI rework, you will continue creating graphics and visual assets for StageTime.



What you will work on

Redesigning the in-game menu UI in Figma.

Creating reusable buttons, panels, icons and UI components.

Improving consistency across the game’s menus.

In-game shop thumbnails and banners.

StageBuck pack artwork.

Sale, promotion and featured-item graphics.

Meta Quest and Steam store artwork.

Event posters and promotional graphics.

Social media and 
 announcement graphics.

Website layouts and web UI.

Update banners, loading screens and seasonal artwork.

Maintaining a consistent visual style across StageTime.



You will not be responsible for implementing the UI in Unity, although Unity experience is a strong advantage.



What we need

A strong portfolio showing game UI or stylised interface design.

Strong Figma skills.

Graphic-design experience beyond UI.

Good understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy and colour.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, Affinity or similar software.

Good written English and communication.



Experience with gaming, Unity, VR or Meta Quest is highly desirable.



How to apply



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Start your application with:



STAGE DESIGN



Then include:



A link to your portfolio.

Your three most relevant examples of game UI, promotional art or graphic design.

The software you use.

Any experience you have working on games.

Whether you own a VR headset.

Confirmation that you can work 20 hours per week for $500 USD per month.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.



Paid trial



We will select a small number of candidates for a paid trial.



You will receive access to StageTime and be asked to explore the current interface and redesign one menu screen in Figma.



The trial will pay $30 USD. The strongest candidate will be offered the part-time role.

title: Content Producer (Video & Graphics Design)
description:
ROLE: Senior Content Producer

REPORTS TO:  Senior Content Producer

LOCATION:  Remote (global)

ENGAGEMENT:  Full
-term contract

HOURS: Monday - Friday (9 am - 5 pm)



ABOUT LN & CO.

LN & Co. is a multicultural digital marketing agency built on a simple idea: culture comes first, and technology carries it. Founded by Layla E. Nielsen, we help brands connect with women and multicultural audiences through social media strategy, content, and community that honor who those audiences really are. Our clients span faith-based organizations, nonprofits, beauty brands, and technology companies, and our small global team produces work that looks and feels like it belongs to each one of them.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a Content Producer to own the creative output behind our clients’ social media. You will turn monthly content calendars into finished video and graphics that are ready to publish, and you will be the person who takes a client’s design brief or a round of feedback and shapes it into work that lands the first time.



The heart of this role is translation. A client sends notes, a brief, or reference material, and you turn it into scroll-stopping Reels, short-form video, and branded graphics that hold up on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and everywhere else they live. You will report to Joanne Gonzalez, our Design Lead, and partner closely with account managers and coordinators across several client accounts at once. If you love the craft of taking rough direction and raw footage and making something polished and on-brand out of it, this is your seat.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Produce short-form video and Reels for client accounts, editing client-provided footage into finished pieces up to around 60 seconds, complete with captions, on-screen text, and platform-ready formatting.



Design custom graphics and multi-slide carousels that follow each client’s brand standards and our own visual system.



Read client design briefs and revision notes closely and turn them into finished assets with minimal back and forth.



Work from monthly content calendars on a rolling production schedule, hitting publish dates and moving cleanly through revision rounds.



Keep every piece consistent with the client’s brand and with our Culture + Technology approach, which centers women and multicultural audiences in the work rather than treating them as an afterthought.



Manage your production queue in Notion, coordinate with account managers and coordinators, and flag anything that needs a client decision early.



Adapt each piece to the platform it lives on, from a vertical Reel to a LinkedIn carousel, with the pacing and format each one rewards.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Five or more years producing social media content, ideally in an agency or fast-moving brand setting, with a portfolio or reel we can watch.



Strong short-form video editing skills and comfort in tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or their equivalents, plus a good ear for pacing, captions, and sound.



Graphic design ability across static posts and carousels, fluent in the Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or both, with a clean, editorial eye.



A real track record of taking client feedback and briefs and delivering exactly what was asked, without needing three rounds to get there.



Command of how content performs across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads,
, and YouTube, and a feel for how each one is different.



Cultural fluency and genuine care for producing work that represents women and multicultural audiences with depth, not decoration.



The organization to juggle several clients and deadlines at once, and the judgment to protect quality while you do it.



Must be available Eastern Standard Time from 9am - 5pm (Required)



NICE TO HAVE

Light copywriting for captions and on-screen text.



Experience with Sprout Social, Metricool, or similar scheduling and reporting tools.



Motion graphics or basic animation.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and portfolio or showreel along with a short note about one piece you produced from someone else’s brief, and what you did to make it stronger, and
 it to

title: Property Manager & Executive Assistant
description:
I’m a real estate entrepreneur based in Dallas, Texas, running two connected businesses: a real estate sales team that helps buyers and sellers, and a property management company that operates furnished co-living rentals. We use ClickUp for task and project management and Google Drive as our primary file system. We also use Buildium as our main property management tool.



I’m looking for a full-time Property Manager who becomes the operational hub for the property management side of the business — overseeing day-to-day execution, tenant and vendor coordination, and ensuring our systems and processes are followed accurately and consistently as we continue to scale.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Serve as a primary point of contact for tenants, vendors, and taskers (escalating issues as needed)

- Coordinate furnishing installs, turns, maintenance requests, and vendor schedules

- Coordinate closely with the Property Management Department Lead to align priorities and next steps

- Review applications and move qualified leads through the leasing pipeline daily

- Execute workflows in ClickUp and Buildium (statuses, due dates, tags, notes, and documentation)

- Manage day-to-day conversations with tenants and vendors to keep items moving

- Help create and document SOPs for recurring workflows

- Maintain and update SOPs/process documentation as changes are made, ensuring the team is working off the latest version

- Ensure follow-up and closure on every open item — nothing falls through the cracks



YOU’D BE A GREAT FIT IF

- You have property management experience

- You follow instructions exactly and don’t cut corners

- You write and speak clearly in English

- You stay calm managing many moving parts

- You take ownership and don’t need hand-holding

- You take initiative: you spot issues early, investigate, and propose next steps/solutions

- You use good judgment and can prioritize without being told every step

- You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can adapt quickly as priorities shift

- Tools experience preferred: Buildium, ClickUp, Google Workspace (we will train — instruction-following matters more than expertise)



ROLE DETAILS

- Full-time, remote

- Schedule: Mon–Fri, aligned with CST

- Pay: $4-6 USD/hour, based on experience

- Long-term role with growth and bonuses



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications that don’t follow instructions are disqualified.



STEP 1 —

2. Subject line: Property Manager – [Full Name]

3. Message body must include only:

- A Google Drive folder link

- Your answer to the Detail Check (see Step 3)

2. Set sharing to “Anyone with the link can view.”

3. You can organize the folder however you think is best. I will be looking at both what you submit and how you organize it.

4. Include the following:

b. Tech and Setup

   - Include a screenshot of your computer specs showing RAM, processor, and OS.

   - Include one photo of your current workspace (desk and computer).

c. Written Answers (one Google Doc)

e. Video Introduction (2–4 minutes)

title: Part-Time Content Marketing Specialist
description:
Company: Stern Bridge LLC

Reports To: Chief of Staff

Employment Type: Part-Time



?



About Stern Bridge LLC



Stern Bridge LLC is the parent company of Operation Veterans Edge and Stern HealthWorks.



Together, our companies help veterans navigate the VA disability process through education, strategy, medical evidence, and healthcare services.



Everything we create is centered around one mission:



Helping veterans make informed decisions while building trust through honest, educational content.



As our companies continue to grow, we’re looking for a Content Marketing Specialist who can help us dramatically expand our content production across multiple brands and platforms.



?



?? READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



This is NOT a typical Social Media Manager position.



If you’re looking for a job where you simply schedule posts or wait to be told exactly what to do next, this position is not for you.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys creating, improving, organizing, and building.



Someone who naturally asks:



* How can this be better?

* How can this be faster?

* What are competitors doing?

* Can AI improve this workflow?

* Can this one video become five pieces of content?



If you’re someone who takes ownership and enjoys solving problems without constant direction, you’ll probably love working here.



?



Minimum Requirements



1. Advanced CapCut Editing



You must be able to take 2–3 raw videos (approximately 3 minutes each) and transform them into multiple engaging 30–60 second videos using:



* Dynamic editing

* Motion graphics

* Auto captions

* Zooms

* B-roll

* Attention-retention editing

* Native short-form pacing



?



2. Digital Asset Management



You must know how to organize and maintain a professional digital asset library.



This includes organizing:



* Raw footage

* Edited videos

* Canva projects

* Carousel graphics

* Brand assets

* Logos

* AI-generated graphics

* B-roll

* Templates



The founder and other tea
mbers should never have to “figure out where something is.”



?



3. Carousel Creation



You should be comfortable creating educational carousel posts that are visually appealing, easy to read, and aligned with our brand.



?



4. AI Content Creation



You should already be using AI as part of your workflow.



This includes using AI to help generate:



* Graphics

* Images

* Captions

* Content ideas

* Script improvements

* Creative variations



We care about the quality of the final product—not whether AI helped create it.



?



5. Canva



You should be proficient in Canva and capable of producing professional marketing assets.



?



6. Strong Branding Eye



You naturally recognize:



* Consistent branding

* Typography

* Color usage

* Layout

* Visual hierarchy

* Professional presentation



Every piece of content should immediately feel like it belongs to our brands.



?



7. Self-Starter Mentality



This is extremely important.



We’re looking for someone who naturally researches:



* Competitors

* Industry trends

* Better workflows

* Better AI tools

* Better ways to create content



If you require someone to constantly tell you what to do next, this is not the right position.



?



8. Content Calendar Management



You should have experience organizing and maintaining publishing calendars across multiple brands and multiple social platforms.



?



9. Script Writing



You should be comfortable writing and improving short-form scripts.



This includes developing multiple hook variations for A/B testing.



Using AI is absolutely encouraged.



However…



If your workflow is simply:



“I asked ChatGPT once and copied the first answer.”



…this probably isn’t the right fit.



We expect you to iterate, improve, test, and refine.



?



Bonus Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel (GHL)

* Funnels

* Landing Pages

* Marketing Hooks

* Basic Marketing Analytics

* Copywriting

* Veteran or Healthcare Industry experience



?



Availability Expectations



This is a remote, part-time position with flexible working hours.



We care far more about results than punching a clock.



However, because you’ll work closely with the founder, you must be responsive during normal U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours when collaboration is needed.



Day-to-day priorities and project management will be handled by our Chief of Staff, while you’ll work directly with the founder on creative direction and major initiatives.



?



Position Summary



As our Content Marketing Specialist, you’ll work directly with the founder to transform ideas into engaging content across multiple brands.



This is a content production and brand execution role.



You’ll help manage content for:



* Operation Veterans Edge

* Stern HealthWorks

* Future Stern Bridge brands



You’ll take raw ideas, videos, AI-generated concepts, educational material, and existing content and transform them into professional content that educates, builds trust, and expands our reach.



?



Responsibilities



Content Production



* Edit short-form videos using CapCut.

* Create educational carousel posts.

* Design graphics using Canva.

* Produce thumbnails and cover images.

* Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form assets.

* Develop multiple versions of scripts and hooks.

* Create platform-specific content for TikTok,
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.



?



Content Management



* Schedule and publish content across multiple platforms.

* Maintain publishing calendars.

* Organize digital assets.

* Maintain templates and reusable content.

* Ensure branding remains consistent across all brands.



?



Creative Development



* Research competitors.

* Research content trends.

* Bring new content ideas to the team.

* Identify opportunities to improve engagement.

* Experiment with AI tools.

* Continuously improve production workflows.



?



Success In This Role



Within your first 90 days:



* Content is consistently published across all brands.

* The founder rarely edits or schedules content.

* Our asset library is clean, organized, and easy to navigate.

* Existing content is routinely repurposed into multiple assets.

* New creative ideas are brought to the team without being requested.

* Our overall content output has increased significantly.



?



Who We’re Looking For



You enjoy creating.



You enjoy organizing.



You enjoy learning.



You enjoy improving systems.



You don’t wait for permission to solve problems.



You notice opportunities others miss.



You care about producing content that genuinely helps people.



Most importantly…



You’re excited about helping build something meaningful.



?



What We Offer



* Fully remote position

* Flexible schedule

* Part-time employment with opportunity for additional hours as the company grows

* Direct collaboration with the founder

* Opportunity to help build multiple rapidly growing brands

* Significant opportunity for advancement as Stern Bridge LLC continues to expand



?



Our Culture



We’re a small team that moves quickly.



We value:



* Ownership

* Curiosity

* Speed

* Continuous improvement

* Professionalism

* Initiative



We don’t expect perfection.



We expect progress.



We’re looking for someone who wants to build something meaningful—not someone who’s simply looking for another social media job.

title: Content Strategist & Script Writer for Day1 Agency (NYC Based Social Media Agency)
description:
Day1 Agency is a NYC based social media and content agency producing viral short form video content for a growing roster of US brands across lifestyle, health, food, and service industries. Our content has generated hundreds of millions of views across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and
. You can see our work at 



We are looking for a Content Strategist and Script Writer who can own the creative and strategic layer of our content production. This is not a task execution role. This is a role for someone who thinks deeply about what makes content work, stays on top of trends before anyone else, and can write scripts that stop scrollers in the first 3 seconds. You will own script drafting, trend research, creative ideation, content calendars, and post production briefs for our in house editor. You will work directly with the founder and the broader team.



Core responsibilities:



Write scripts for short form video content across multiple client brands (target 15 to 25 scripts per week)

Research and identify trends on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts that are relevant to each client

Build weekly and monthly content calendars for each client

Develop creative concepts and series ideas that can become repeatable content formats

Write post production briefs for the editor so edits align with the intended creative vision

Analyze competitor content and surface insights we can apply to our work

Stay deeply plugged into US culture, internet humor, and platform specific trends



Core skills we are looking for:



Proven experience writing short form video scripts that have performed well

Deep understanding of US based audience behavior, cultural references, and platform algorithms

Strong research skills and ability to quickly learn new industries and brand voices

Experience working in a social media or content agency is a significant plus

Excellent written English



Key traits we are looking for:



Proactive and self driven (this is the single most important trait)

Brings ideas to the team without being asked

Takes ownership of projects rather than waiting for instructions

Flexible and adaptable across different brands and creative styles

Has strong opinions about what makes content work



Rate and hours:

Rate: $12 to $15 per hour USD depending on experience

Hours: 15 to 20 hours per week to start, with room to grow

EST working hours preferred for team collaboration, though we are flexible on the execution work



How to apply:

Before applying, please take 5 minutes to look at our work at day1.agency so you understand the kind of content we create.

In your application, please include the following three things:



A brief paragraph about your experience writing short form video scripts, including the types of brands or content you have worked on.

Three content ideas for a laundry pickup app targeting Gen Z in NYC. These should be specific enough to actually produce, not generic concepts. Include the hook, the premise, and why you think it would work.

title: A-Player DM Setter For Men’s Coaching Brand (Performance-Based, Long Term)
description:
Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



We sell €3.5k–€20k coaching programs to men worldwide. Most clients come from DM conversations.



We already flood Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X/Twitter with content. Inbound and outbound conversations are only going up.



I have a full Content Operating System and A-player closers.



Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is:

Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results.



If that excites you, keep reading.



MISSION OF THE ROLE



Turn warm attention from my content into qualified booked calls for my sales team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others).

- On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when automations have done their part and a human is needed.

- Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team.

- Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results.

- Be measured on:

- Conversations started

- Calls booked

- Show-up rate

- Sales from your sets



This is appointment setting, not closing. No cold calling, no “spray and pray”. You talk to people who already follow or engage with me.



DAY-TO-DAY



- Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads).

- Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training.

- Start DMs with warm leads:

- People who comment with clear pain/interest

- Story viewers / voters (when handed to you)

- Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you

- Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit).

- Handle basic objections in DMs (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call.

- Book calls on the correct calendar with all required notes.

- Keep simple tracking of:

- Who you talked to

- Who booked from your DMs

- Who showed up

- Who bought (for commissions)

- Follow up old leads consistently.

- Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (“how do I work with you?”) and move them into DMs.

- Work closely with me and my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field.



You will not create content or do generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs do not drain you.

- Written English is 9/10+. You sound natural, not robotic.

- You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if it was for coaches, consultants or fitness).

- You can show proof (numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies) that you have actually booked calls and driven revenue.

- You are hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a small fixed salary.

- You like being measured. Numbers do not scare you.

- You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with Dubai and US/Europe time zones.

- You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays.



Nice-to-have (not required):

- Certificates in appointment setting / sales. If you have them, send them.



NOT FOR YOU IF



- You are scared of rejection or pushback in DMs.

- You have zero sales reps and zero proof.

- You need someone to tell you what to do every minute.

- You are just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days.



COMPENSATION



This is performance-driven.



- Base: 200–300 USD/month (depending on experience)

- Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set

- Our programs are €3,500–€20,000

- Even at the low end, 3–5% is about 110–300+ USD per sale



Realistic on-target earnings once ramped:

- 15–25+ calls booked/month

- 30–40% close rate by our closers

You can make 800–1,800+ USD/month once you are dialed in. There is no cap.



SCHEDULE



- About 35–40 hours/week spread across:

- Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed)

- Sun: lighter check-ins and follow-ups



You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever”.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



- At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS or similar).

- Very strong written English (we will test this).

- Stable internet + backup (data or second connection) and a quiet place to work.

- Comfortable using:

- Instagram /
 / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs

- Google Sheets / basic CRM

- Loom / Zoom for training

- Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



1) Subject line / OnlineJobs title:

A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name]



2) In your message, include short, direct answers to:



a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences).



b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer? Share numbers.



c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you.



d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here?



e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun.



f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs:

- Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (for example: “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”),

- Any certificates in setting/sales (optional but a plus).



3) OPTIONAL (big plus):

Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you:

- Introduce yourself

- Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call

- Explain why you’re the best choice for this role



Generic or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I am only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term.



If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Marketing Operations Manager



**Company:** GoNano

**Reports to:** Charles Dumont (CMO) 

**Type:** Full-time

**Start date:** Immediate 

---

## How to Apply - VERY IMPORTANT STEP IF YOU WANT TO BE CONSIDERED.



Send us:

1. A short Loom (under 5 minutes) walking through a closed-loop attribution system you've built or maintained — what tools, what stages, what worked, what didn't

2. A second short Loom (under 3 minutes) showing how you currently use Claude or another AI tool in your marketing ops workflow — bonus points if you can demo the HubSpot MCP connector live

3. Your resume or LinkedIn

4. One sentence: what's the most broken thing you've ever fixed in HubSpot?



## About GoNano



GoNano is a nanotechnology infrastructure preservation company and the category leader in Structural Roof Rejuvenation. We work through a network of 420+ Certified Contractors (CCs) across North America who install our products on residential and commercial properties. We operate two parallel funnels: a B2B funnel recruiting and supporting CCs, and a B2C funnel generating homeowner demand that we route to local CCs. Both funnels need to be measured end-to-end — from first ad impression to signed deal — and that's where you come in.



## What You'll Own



You'll be the connective tissue between our ad spend and our pipeline. Every dollar our external ad agency (led by Korey) spends on Meta, Google, or anywhere else needs to map cleanly to a lead, a contact, a deal, and ultimately revenue — across both our B2B (CC recruitment) and B2C (homeowner) motions. Today, that connection is partially built. Your job is to finish it, maintain it, and make it sing.



You're not building custom software. We have HubSpot, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GTM, Calendly, Supabase, and a growing stack of best-in-class SaaS tools. You're the person who configures them properly, integrates them natively, and gets them talking to each other without writing application code.



## Core Responsibilities



**HubSpot Operations**

- Own HubSpot as a system: workflows, custom properties, custom objects, lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, lead scoring, and lead routing

- Build and maintain reporting dashboards for both B2B and B2C funnels, including CAC by source, funnel velocity, conversion rates by rep and by stage, and CC market performance

- Maintain data hygiene: deduplication, attribution touchpoint cleanup, UTM governance



**Ad Platform Integration — Direct Partnership With Korey**

- Work hand-in-hand with Korey (our external ad agency lead) to ensure every pixel, tag, conversion event, and audience sync is configured correctly and firing cleanly across Meta, Google, and any other platforms we test

- Own the integrity of the tracking layer: when Korey launches a campaign, you've already verified that conversions will attribute back, audiences will sync, and the data will land in HubSpot

- Be Korey's technical counterpart inside GoNano — when he needs a custom audience built, a conversion event added, or a tracking issue diagnosed, you're his first call

- Run weekly tracking-health checks across all ad accounts and report anomalies before they cost us money



**Closed-Loop Attribution**

- Configure and maintain the Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) using native integrations

- Set up Google Ads Enhanced Conversions and offline conversion imports from HubSpot deal stages

- Build and maintain GTM containers across 
, 
, and 

- Ensure every lead carries a complete attribution trail: first touch, last touch, multi-touch, ad ID, campaign, content

- Wire HubSpot deal stages back to ad platforms as conversion events so Korey can optimize on revenue, not just leads

- Maintain our first-party attribution layer (existing architecture uses Supabase + UTM capture + HubSpot webhooks — you'll operate and tune it, not rebuild it)



**B2C Lead Enrichment**

- Configure IP-to-identity enrichment tools (RB2B, Warmly, Clearbit, or similar) to capture anonymous site visitors and route qualified leads into HubSpot

- Build the bridge between anonymous traffic and known contacts



**AI-Native Reporting & Workflow**

- We run lean and move fast because we use AI tools — particularly Claude — as a daily extension of our team. You'll be expected to do the same.

- You should be fluent in using Claude with HubSpot's MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector to pull reports, query contact and deal data, and surface insights in minutes instead of building a report from scratch each time

- You'll use Claude to draft workflow logic, debug tracking issues, summarize campaign performance, and accelerate the operational work — not to replace your judgment, but to multiply your output

- If you've never used Claude with MCP connectors, you'll need to demonstrate that you can pick it up quickly and that you're already comfortable working with AI tools as a core part of your day



**Cross-Functional Coordination**

- Brief Korey weekly on what's converting and what isn't, with the data to back it

- Work with Neda (Marketing Manager) on campaign setup, UTM standards, and launch checklists

- Support Joel on CC lifecycle reporting — registration to first install to active CC

- Flag broken tracking, attribution gaps, or platform changes before they cost us money



## You Are a Strong Fit If



- 4+ years in marketing operations, RevOps, or a similar role at a B2B or B2B2C company

- HubSpot Operations Hub certified, with hands-on experience building workflows, custom objects, and lead routing logic at scale (300+ contact records, multiple pipelines)

- You've personally configured Meta CAPI and Google Enhanced Conversions on at least one production account

- You've worked directly with an external ad agency or media buyer as their technical counterpart and made their campaigns more measurable

- Comfortable in GTM, with the judgment to know when a tag belongs client-side vs. server-side

- Read and write SQL well enough to validate reports, but you'd rather build the right dashboard than write the query every time

- You think in funnels and lifecycle stages, not just campaigns and clicks

- You're already using Claude (or comparable AI tools) daily and have hands-on experience with MCP connectors — particularly the HubSpot connector — to query data, generate reports, and accelerate operational work

- You have a portfolio, case study, or detailed reference you can walk us through showing a closed-loop attribution system you built or maintained

- Strong written English — most of our collaboration is async via Slack and Loom



## Bonus Points For



- Experience with dealer, franchise, or distributor network models

- Familiarity with first-party attribution architectures (Hyros, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or custom-built equivalents)

- Experience with Next.js / Netlify-hosted sites (we use both — you don't need to code, but understanding the architecture helps)

- Trade / home services / construction industry experience

- French language comfort (we operate in Quebec)



## What This Role Is NOT



- A pure analyst role — you'll be configuring systems, not just reporting on them

- A developer role — you won't be writing Netlify Functions or building custom applications

- A media buying role — Korey handles that; you make sure his work is measurable



## First 60 Days — Aggressive Timeline



We need data flowing cleanly by **end of June 2026**. This is non-negotiable. Here's the plan:



- **Days 1–14:** Audit current HubSpot setup, Meta/Google ad accounts, GTM containers, and attribution flow alongside Korey. Deliver a written gap analysis with priority order.

- **Days 15–30:** Close the highest-priority gaps — CAPI configuration, deal-stage-to-ad-platform conversion sync, UTM governance across both sites, and pixel verification with Korey on every active campaign.

- **Days 31–60:** Deliver the v1 closed-loop dashboard showing ad spend ? signed CC and ad spend ? homeowner lead ? routed-to-CC, with confidence intervals on attribution. Data must be flowing, clean, and actionable by month-end.



If you can't credibly meet these requirements, this isn't the role for you.

title: Lead Engine Specialist
description:
Do you light up when you get someone on the phone?



If you're the person who would rather make 50 calls than send 50
s — who genuinely enjoys striking up a conversation with a stranger and finding out what's going on in their world — keep reading. This role was built for you.



Sure Home Buyers helps homeowners across Southwest Missouri sell their property quickly and without the hassle of a traditional listing. Behind every deal is one thing: a real conversation with a homeowner who needed a solution. You are the person who starts those conversations and keeps them going.



This is the cornerstone seat in our business. You generate the leads, build the relationships, nurture the maybes, and hand truly motivated sellers to our acquisitions team ready to talk. When you do this well, the whole business moves.



Who we are



We're a startup with one clear goal: to become the go-to home buyer in Southwest Missouri — not the biggest, the most trusted.



The people we help are usually in a tough spot. Facing foreclosure. Holding a property they never wanted or inherited. Tangled in a complex title problem they don't know how to solve. They don't need a sales pitch — they need a way out. Our job is to listen first, build a creative solution that actually fits their situation, and hand them back something they've been missing: peace of mind.



That shapes who we hire. We serve, we don't pressure. The right person for this seat genuinely cares about the person on the other end of the line — and then knows how to move the conversation forward. Hold both, and you'll fit right in. And because we're early, you're getting in on the ground floor of something we're building to last.



What you'll own



Reach out — warm and cold. Spend the majority of your day on the phone and texting. Cold outreach to fresh lists, warm follow-up with people who've already raised a hand, and fast response to inbound leads.

Follow the script, read the room. We give you proven scripts for each lead type. You'll know them cold and still sound like a human, not a robot.

Set the appointments. Your number-one outcome: book qualified appointments for our acquisitions team — multiple per week from genuinely motivated sellers.

Run a clean CRM. Pull and load lead lists, log every touch, take detailed notes, update statuses, and keep our pipeline organized and current. No lead falls through the cracks on your watch.

Enrich the data. Dig in and fill out every lead record — phone numbers, owner details, property info — so we know as much as possible about every person before we call.

Nurture the funnel. Stay on top of follow-up so warm leads don't go cold and every motivated seller keeps moving toward a conversation with acquisitions.

What a good week looks like



You've worked your lists hard, had real conversations with dozens of homeowners, your CRM is spotless, and you've set several solid appointments with sellers who actually want to talk. Acquisitions opens their calendar and the next steps are obvious. You go into the weekend knowing exactly what you produced — and so do we.



Who you are



You love talking to people. This is non-negotiable. The phone energizes you; it doesn't drain you.

You're relentlessly organized. Notes, follow-ups, and CRM hygiene are second nature.

You're goal-oriented. You like a target and you like hitting it. You measure your day in conversations and appointments.

You're coachable and self-directed. You'll follow our scripts and systems, and you'll run your day without someone standing over you.

Bonus, not required: experience in real estate, sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, customer service, or any phone-heavy role.

Compensation



This is a performance-based 1099 contract built to reward activity and results:



Paid per qualified contact you make

Paid per appointment you set

Bonus on every deal that closes — uncapped

The harder and smarter you work the phone, the more you earn. If you're driven and consistent, this rewards you for it.



The details



Schedule: Part-time, flexible hours within standard calling windows

Classification: 1099 independent contractor

Location: Fully remote. We're prioritizing candidates local to Southwest Missouri, but strong candidates anywhere will be considered.

The work: Phone and text the majority of the time. You'll need a reliable computer, a quiet space, and solid internet.

How to apply — read this carefully



Because this role is all about how you connect with people, your application starts with your voice.



Send two things to 



A 60-second-or-less video of yourself. Tell us who you are and why you'd be great at talking to homeowners all day. Don't overthink it — a phone selfie video is perfect. We want to see your energy.

Your resume.

That's it. Applications without a video won't be reviewed — the video is the first step. We're excited to meet you.

As a BDR, you’ll be on the front lines of our sales efforts, identifying potential clients, generating leads, and nurturing opportunities to connect them with our solutions.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Proactively research and identify potential customers in target markets.

2. Reach out to prospects via
s, LinkedIn, and other communication channels.

3. Qualify leads to assess fit and interest, ensuring alignment with our services.

4. Schedule meetings or product demos between qualified leads and Sales Development Representatives.

5. Maintain accurate records of lead interactions and update CRM systems accordingly.

6. Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to execute campaigns and optimize lead generation strategies.

7. Stay up-to-date on industry trends and our product/service offerings to effectively communicate value propositions.



Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- 2 - 3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a similar role (entry-level candidates with strong communication skills and a hunger to learn are also encouraged to apply).

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

- Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and eager to exceed targets.

- Proficiency in extracting data from LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other professional networks

- Must have a well-optimized LinkedIn account with atleast a minimum of 300 connections that can be used for prospecting

- Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, PipeDrive) is a plus.

- Comfortable with cold outreach and prospecting.



Who we are:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.



What we value:

Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions

Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated

Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions

Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough

Discipline - Be consistent in your actions

Ambition - Aspire to become better every day

Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.



Interested applicants may send updated CVs and LinkedIn URLs to the contact person's
 address indicated below

 Subject: Business Development Representative

title: Appointment Setter — Health & Fitness Coaching (Part-Time)

title: PART-TIME SOCIAL MEDIA COMMENT & DM MODERATOR (FACEBOOK + INSTAGRAM) — LONG-TERM ROLE, US ECOMMERCE BRAND
description:
We are a US-based ecommerce company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented moderator to manage the comments and direct messages on our
 and Instagram pages. This is a long-term, permanent part-time position — we are looking for someone who wants stable work with one company, not a short project.



THE JOB



Our pages get a steady flow of comments and DMs: product questions, praise, order issues, and some negativity. Your job is to keep everything handled:



- Answer product questions using our AI-assisted reply system (we provide it — you never need product knowledge, and you never guess)

- Hide hostile comments that can't be usefully answered (hide, never delete — we'll train you on our exact rules)

- Route order and shipping issues to our customer service team through Slack

- Immediately escalate anything serious (legal threats, PR risk, big-account attention) to the owners

- Leave harmless comments alone — most comments need nothing



You'll do 4 short check-ins per day, spread across US Eastern time. Most check-ins take 10–20 minutes; on busy days they run longer. Plan for up to 1.5–2 hours of total daily work including a short end-of-day log, though most days are lighter. The check-in windows (both clocks shown):



- Morning US ET ? around 8–9 PM Philippine time

- Midday US ET ? around 12 midnight Philippine time

- 4–5 PM US ET ? around 4–5 AM Philippine time

- 9–10 PM US ET ? around 9–10 AM Philippine time



Please only apply if this schedule genuinely works for you — it spans the Philippine night. Coverage includes weekends, with a lighter schedule (2 check-ins instead of 4).



At the end of each working day you'll write a short log of what you handled. We're an async company — nobody micromanages you, and your log is how your work is seen.



REQUIREMENTS (all of these are hard requirements)



- Proven experience moderating or managing
 and Instagram pages — you must link proof in your application (pages you've managed, screenshots of moderation work, or a portfolio). Applications without linked proof will be rejected.

- Experience using Claude (the AI assistant by Anthropic)

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet connection AND backup power/internet for outages

- Individual applicants only — no agencies or teams. The person who applies is the person who does the work, on their own account.

- Available for all four daily check-in windows listed above



PAY



$200 USD/month, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth and an expanded role (posting, community management) as the company grows — we are building a long-term team, and this role is designed to get bigger for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.



1. Start your application with the word POLARIS on the first line.

2. Link your proof of moderation experience (see requirements).

3. Confirm you can cover all four daily check-in windows, including weekends.

4. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you moderate the page of a consumer product. Four comments come in. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take — REPLY, HIDE, ESCALATE to the owner, or DO NOTHING — and give one sentence explaining why.



   a) "Does this come in a bigger size?"

   b) "Total garbage company, anyone who buys this is an idiot ????"

   c) "I used this and had a bad reaction. My lawyer will be contacting you."

   d) "Love mine!! Best purchase this year ????"



We read every application that follows the instructions. Shortlisted candidates will have a short interview. We're hiring as soon as we find the right person.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are a U.S.-based B2B industrial supply business looking for a graphic designer to support our ongoing e-commerce, marketing, and product documentation work.



1. Position Summary

We need a graphic designer who can produce clean, industrial-style visual assets across multiple formats — enhanced product content, e-commerce listing imagery, website imagery, packaging, labels, infographics, and product documentation.

Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply.

That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing.

This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit.

The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement.



2. Scope of Work

The designer will produce visual assets including:

Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners)

Website images and banners

Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement)

Box and packaging design

Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides

Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print)

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support

Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed



3. Required Skills & Experience

Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples

Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable.

A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation.

Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats)

Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy

Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools

Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets



To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

title: Architect
description:
THIS IS A REPOST OF A RECENT JOB OPENING THAT IS NOT FILLED.  I had a couple of talented architects but we found we had some knowledge based gaps.  I found I need someone with a bit deeper skillset and who understands topography and US building standards better.  



Since this is a remote position some of these requirements will be tweaked.  You would be communicating with our team and clients remotely via
, WhatsApp, and possibly via video on FaceTime or Zoom.  I may tweak this description as I see what responses I get.  Thank you for taking the time to apply and for giving me all the info I need to make a great decision.



Job Description

Who We Are

We are a small design-build custom home and renovation firm based in NC, serving the mountains of Western North Carolina. We handle everything in-house, from initial design through final construction, which means our designer isn't handing drawings off to someone else and walking away. You're part of the build from first sketch to finished product.

We're a small, high-performing team that takes on fewer projects intentionally so we can do each one right. I have found that I need to include a bit of detail in the job post to see if you actually read it all.  I find that at least 50% don't read it all.  If you skip over all of these it means you are just blasting out responses and have no attention to detail and I will delete your application. Our clients are homeowners and investors who expect precision, professionalism, and a design partner who listens. We've built our reputation on doing exactly that.



The Role

We're looking for an Architectural Designer who brings real expertise and takes ownership of the design function. You'll work directly with clients from early concept through construction documentation, collaborating daily with our project managers and pre-construction team. You'll be in the “room” virtually” if needed for the conversations that matter.

We want someone who brings strong judgment, exercises initiative, and raises the quality of our work.



What You'll Do

Lead design development across all phases, from initial programming and schematic concepts through design development and construction documentation

Understand client design meetings and selections appointments, work with our interior designer and clients through material, finish, and specification decisions across multiple rounds

Produce construction drawings and documentation that our project managers can build from without ambiguity

Create renderings and visual presentations that communicate design intent clearly to clients

In your response, tell me the difference between European & US style windows.

Collaborate with pre-construction on design-driven cost estimates and value engineering decisions

Maintain design intent through the build by staying engaged with the field team during construction

In your response, tell me what hourly rate you need and your minimum and maximum hours you would work.

Contribute to improving our internal design process as the company grows



What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in residential design, preferably custom homes or high-end renovation

Required proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp or other similar software

In your response tell me how big a 2x4 and a 2x10 is.

Experience producing high-quality renderings for client presentations

Working knowledge of US residential building codes and construction methods; familiarity with North Carolina codes is a plus

A portfolio that demonstrates design sensibility, complete construction documents, and client-ready renderings

In your response, tell me the clearances required for bathroom fixtures.

Clear communicator who handles client relationships with confidence and works well without heavy oversight

In your response, tell me why you are the right fit for this role.

Familiarity with design-build delivery is a plus; genuine interest in how buildings get built is non-negotiable

Bonus if you bring experience with: Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, ArchiCAD, Chief Architect, Adobe Creative Suite, or Bluebeam



Salary

Please provide your required hourly rate.



Why This Role

You'll have direct influence over a company's design direction, not executing someone else's vision as one of many. You'll work with a team that respects craft, holds high standards, and takes pride in the finished product. 



To Apply

Send a sample of your work that would be ready to permit in the US market.  Apply directly through Onlinejobs.ph. Include your portfolio with your application, demonstrating your design work, construction documents, and renderings. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Are you an experienced social media manager looking for a long-term position with ongoing educational training about social media? You might be just the right person we're looking for!



Just Simply Marketing (JSM) is a digital marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada, dedicated to helping business coaches, speakers, and experts from the US and Canada build, grow, and monetize their online brands. Specializing in organic marketing strategies, we focus on content creation, social media management, lead generation, and video production to help our clients stand out online. At JSM, we value creativity, excellence, and personal growth in everything we do.



You will work closely with our creatives, video editing and graphic design teams to review and approve videos and designs, ensuring it aligns with our clients' brand and strategy. As our Social Media Manager, you will be the driving force behind our clients' brand growth and increased online presence.



This is a fully remote position with a working hours from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM PHT, Monday - Friday. The Social Media Specialist will have to report directly to the Social Media Team Managers.



How to Apply:

Interested candidates, please apply through our application form: 



RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Content Research: You will analyze and do your research on our clients' brands, market, industry, and competitors to develop effective social media strategies.



2. Content Creation: You will be responsible for generating original and repurposed content ideas that drive engagement and growth. Your innovative and creative mind will help our clients stand out from the crowd.



3. Content Copywriting & Scriptwriting: You will curate meaningful and engaging content that resonates with our clients' target audiences and aligns with their brand identity. This includes writing scroll-stopping captions, scripts, and headlines tailored to different social media platforms.



4. Content Posting: You will handle the scheduling and posting of content across various social media platforms in line with the content calendar and the strategy you've created.



5. Content Analysis and Report: You will generate reports on account performance and audience engagement. These insights will be used to optimize strategies and create better content for our clients.



***Training is provided. Plus you will have access to multiple social media courses.



REQUIREMENTS:

- A minimum of 1 year of experience as a social media manager

- Deep understanding of Instagram,
, Tiktok, and Youtube

- Knows social media trends and the social media industry

- Proven track record in achieving results for your past/current clients' online brands

- Experience in copywriting and understands SEO & keywords

- Looking to work for the long-term and grow within the company

- Experience with 
, Metricool, 
, Google Drive, and Google Docs is highly preferred, but not required



How to Apply:

Interested candidates, please apply through our application form:

title: Pinterest Manager & Growth Specialist (Remote)
description:
About UnityEd

UnityEd is a growing education company that creates premium digital resources, professional toolkits, courses, and implementation systems for educators, school leaders, families, and organizations.



With a catalog of 130+ digital products, we're looking for a proactive Pinterest Manager to help drive consistent traffic, increase product visibility, and grow our Pinterest presence.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of a channel with significant growth potential. You'll have access to established brand assets, Canva templates, product libraries, SOPs, and existing content. You'll be responsible for turning those resources into a consistent Pinterest marketing system.



What You'll Do

As our Pinterest Manager, you'll:

1. Manage UnityEd's Pinterest account.

2. Develop and execute a Pinterest content strategy aligned with our business goals.

3. Create branded Pinterest graphics in Canva.

4. Write SEO-optimized Pinterest titles and descriptions.

5. Conduct Pinterest keyword research.

6. Optimize existing boards and recommend new boards as needed.

7. Repurpose UnityEd products, blog content, and educational resources into Pinterest pins.

8. Schedule and publish pins consistently.

9. Link every pin to the appropriate product, landing page, or resource.

10. Maintain a Pinterest content calendar.

11. Monitor analytics and identify top-performing content.

12. Recommend improvements based on performance data.

13. Organize Pinterest assets and workflows.

14. Provide weekly progress updates and performance insights.

15. Work independently while communicating proactively.



What We're Looking For

You may be an excellent fit if you:

1. Have proven experience managing Pinterest accounts for businesses.

2. Understand Pinterest SEO, keyword research, and search intent.

3. Can design clean, professional Pinterest graphics in Canva.

4. Understand that Pinterest is a visual search engine, not just a social media platform.

5. Have experience marketing digital products, educational content, or online businesses.

6. Have excellent attention to detail.

7. Carefully review spelling, branding, links, and formatting before publishing.

8. Can balance strategy with consistent execution.

9. Manage your workload independently while meeting deadlines.

10. Communicate clearly and proactively.



Success in This Role

We'll provide you with:

- Brand guidelines

- Canva templates

- Product catalog

- Google Drive resources

- SOPs

- Existing content and marketing assets

We're looking for someone who can quickly understand our brand, identify opportunities, and begin producing quality work during the first week.



You don't need to reinvent our system, you'll build upon what's already in place while bringing your own expertise and ideas.



Hours & Compensation

- Starting rate: $4.00 USD/hour

- Flexible part-time hours

- Opportunity for increased hours, higher pay, and additional responsibilities based on performance

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



How to Apply

Please begin your application with the phrase:

"PINTEREST CREATES TRAFFIC"



Then answer the following questions:

1. Tell us about your experience managing Pinterest accounts for businesses.

2. Please provide examples of Pinterest accounts, pins, or Canva designs you've created.

3. What measurable results have you achieved through Pinterest? Please share specific examples whenever possible.

4. Describe your process for conducting Pinterest keyword research.

5. If given access to our catalog of 130+ digital education products, how would you determine which products to promote first?

6. If you received access to our Pinterest account, brand guide, Canva templates, Google Drive, products, and SOPs on Monday, what would you expect to accomplish by the end of your first week?

7. Approximately how many high-quality Pinterest pins can you realistically create, optimize, and schedule within five hours?

8. What quality-control process do you use to ensure every pin has the correct branding, spelling, links, title, description, and destination URL before publishing?

9. If one of your pins significantly outperformed the others in impressions and clicks, what would you do next?

10. Tell us about a time you identified and solved a problem for a client without being asked.

11. Which Pinterest scheduling, analytics, or SEO tools have you used?

12. How do you use AI tools such as ChatGPT while ensuring your final work remains accurate, original, and aligned with the brand?

13. What current clients, employment, or ongoing commitments do you have?

14. How many hours per week can you consistently commit to this position?

15. Are you comfortable starting at $4.00 USD per hour?

16. Why do you believe you'll be successful managing and growing UnityEd's Pinterest presence while working independently?



Please also include:

- Your resume

- Portfolio

- Examples of Pinterest work

- A 2–3 minute Loom (or similar) video introducing yourself and explaining why you're a strong fit for this role



Applications that do not include the required opening phrase, portfolio, responses to all questions, and video introduction will not be considered.



If you're excited about building a Pinterest channel that helps educators discover valuable resources while contributing to a growing mission-driven company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Photo Editor
description:
About the Work



I run a real estate brokerage and need a skilled photo editor to make my listing photos stand out. This is an ongoing, per-job arrangement. You will typically handle about 5 to 6 jobs per month, so this is light, steady work rather than full-time.

For each job, I will
 you a link to a set of raw photos, typically around 40 - 60 finished  images per set. You process them and send the finished images back. Simple and repeatable.



What You'll Do



- Merge HDR brackets into clean, natural-looking images

- Light retouching to polish each photo

- Gentle window pulls so exterior views look bright and clear without going overboard

- Overall color, exposure, and contrast adjustments that make the photos pop while still looking realistic



I am after a natural, high-end look. No blown-out windows, no cartoonish over-processing. Just crisp, inviting real estate photos.



What I'm Looking For



- Strong Lightroom and Photoshop skills or equivalent

- Real estate photo editing experience (please share samples or a portfolio)

- Comfortable with HDR merging and window masking

- Reliable turnaround and clear communication

- Able to take feedback and match a consistent style over time



Terms



- Ongoing, per-job basis

- A typical job is around 40 - 60 finished photos

- Roughly 5 to 6 jobs per month (could be more or less)

- Paid per completed job



If interested please reply with:



- Links to samples of your real estate editing (before and after if possible)

- A short note on your experience with HDR merging and window pulls

- Start the subject line or first line of your reply with the word "SHUTTER" so I know you read this post



Looking forward to seeing your work.
